headline: Public comment and discussion on proposed ZA-27-01 inclusionary zoning amendment.
summary: Staff will present the full ZA-27-01 proposal, followed by discussion among the IZ Working Group. Public comment on the amendment is also on the agenda, followed by a decision on whether to take action on it.
items: Public forum on topics unrelated to ZA-27-01 Inclusionary Zoning, with comments limited to three minutes
Staff presentation of the full ZA-27-01 proposal and working group discussion
Public forum on ZA-27-01 Inclusionary Zoning, with comments limited to three minutes
Planning Commission discussion and possible action on the amendment
location: Zoom, or in person at Bushor Conference Room (Room 102), 1st Floor of City Hall, 149 Church St.

1. Agenda 
  
2. Public Forum for items unrelated to ZA-27-01 Inclusionary Zoning 
  
   
Subject 2.1. The first Public Forum is an opportunity for members of the public to speak 
on topics unrelated to the Collaborative Working Group discussion. The 
Planning Commission requests that comments not exceed three minutes. If you 
expect your comments to exceed three minutes, we ask that you instead 
submit written comments to planninginfo@burlingtonvt.gov. Your written 
communication will be circulated to the Planning Commission, posted online via 
Civic Clerk, and included in the Agenda Packet.  
    
Meeting November 18, 2026 - IZ Collaborative Working Group Agenda - Wednesday, November

4. ZA-27-01 IZ Amendment Presentation & Discussion 
  
   
Subject 4.1. Staff to present the full ZA-27-01 Proposal, followed by a discussion 
among the IZ Working Group. The Planning Commission has the opportunity to 
warn this amendment for a Public Hearing.

5. Public Forum related to ZA-27-01 Inclusionary Zoning 
  
   
Subject 5.1. The second Public Hearing is an opportunity for members of the public to 
speak on ZA-27-01. The Planning Commission requests that comments not 
exceed three minutes. If you expect your comments to exceed three minutes, 
we ask that you instead submit written comments to 
planninginfo@burlingtonvt.gov. Your written communication will be circulated 
to the Planning Commission, posted online via Civic Clerk, and included in the 
Agenda Packet.
